en-US.presentedBy: Live! Casino and Hotel Maryland Presents
en-US.presentedByText: Live! Casino and Hotel Maryland Presents
en-US.description: Music icon Tom Jones brings his legendary voice and timeless hits to The HALL at Live! From classics like “It’s Not Unusual” and “Delilah” to fan favorites like “She’s A Lady", audiences can expect an evening filled with powerhouse vocals, charisma and nonstop entertainment. Don’t miss the chance to experience one of music’s most enduring performers live!

discoveryEventData.bio:
With a career spanning over 50 years, Tom Jones has gone from strength to strength, with his seminal and ubiquitous hits such as ‘It’s Not Unusual’, ‘Kiss’, ‘Delilah’, ‘What’s New Pussycat’, ‘I’ll Never Fall In Love Again’, ‘Sex Bomb’, and more.

Along with sustaining his popularity as a live performer and recording artist for more than five decades, he continues to garner critical acclaim, including with the release of his most recent number 1 album, last year’s ‘Surrounded By Time’. 

The album, the latest in his series of collaborations with producer Ethan Johns, again saw Sir Tom delve further into his love of Blues & Soul, featuring his versions of songs by the likes of Bob Dylan, The Waterboys, Cat Stevens & more.

It is the most recent high point in a career full of highlights, including being knighted by Her Majesty the Queen in 2006. Other highlights of his long career include receiving BRIT Awards for Best Male and Outstanding Contribution to Music, a Silver Clef Award for Lifetime Achievement, the Hitmaker Award from the [US] Songwriters Hall of Fame, GQ Man Of The Year, and the prestigious [UK] Music Industry Trust Award.

venue.title: The HALL at Live!
venue.addressLine: 7002 Arundel Mills Circle, Hanover, MD, United States 21076

venueSeoContents.body:
Located within the Live! Casino & Hotel in Hanover, Maryland, The HALL at Live! is a premier live music and event venue known for its intimate atmosphere and modern design. With a capacity of approximately 4,000 guests, it regularly hosts concerts, comedy shows, and private events, featuring notable performers such as Creed, Sevendust, Gabriel Iglesias, and Jerry Seinfeld.1

Beyond live music, the venue accommodates special events, private gatherings, and entertainment experiences as part of the broader Live! complex. With its flexible layout and state-of-the-art production capabilities, it offers an engaging setting for both local and touring acts.

Score your The HALL at Live! tickets at AXS and experience unforgettable live entertainment and music events.

Before heading to The HALL at Live!, guests should review the venue’s policies to plan ahead and ensure a smooth experience.

  • Re-Entry & Smoking: The HALL at Live! enforces a no-re-entry policy. Smoking, including cigarettes, vaping devices, and electronic cigarettes, is prohibited in the casino and event center. Smoking is restricted to designated areas only.2
  • Payment Options: The HALL at Live! may operate as a cashless venue, with most transactions typically requiring a credit or debit card. Guests should refer to the venue website for the most up-to-date guidance.
  • Prohibited Items: Outside food and beverages, professional cameras, and weapons of any kind are prohibited at The HALL at Live!. Check the official prohibited and permitted items page for the complete list of prohibited items.2
  • Age Restrictions: Many events at The HALL at Live! are designated as 21+ because of their connection to the casino, but guests should always check the specific listing for age requirements before attending.1

For the most up-to-date guidance and information on regulations (including bag policies), check the official The HALL at Live! Code of Conduct Guide.

venueSeoContents.header: Discover other Venues in the Area
venueSeoContents.body:
Home to a variety of sports and entertainment venues, the nearby Baltimore area is a vibrant destination filled with dining, nightlife, and cultural attractions. It’s a lively year-round destination:

  • Oriole Park at Camden Yards: Oriole Park at Camden Yards is an iconic ballpark that’s home to the Baltimore Orioles, known for its retro-style design and historic charm, with seating for about 45,000 fans.5
  • M&T Bank Stadium: M&T Bank Stadium is the home to the Baltimore Ravens. The stadium hosts NFL games, concerts, and major events, with a capacity of approximately 71,000 guests.6
  • CFG Bank Arena: The CFG Bank Arena is a premier indoor arena in downtown Baltimore that hosts concerts, family shows, and sporting events, with a capacity of around 14,000.7

venueSeoContents.header: The HALL at Live! Parking and Directions
venueSeoContents.body:
The HALL at Live! is located within the Live! complex at the Live! Casino & Hotel Maryland. The venue offers convenient parking and is easily accessible from the surrounding Baltimore area, making it simple for guests arriving by car or public transit.

Public Transportation: The venue is served by Baltimore’s Maryland Transit Administration (MTA) buses and nearby light rail stops, providing easy access for guests who prefer public transit.3

Driving: The HALL at Live! Is located within the Live! Complex at 7002 Arundel Mills Circle, Hanover, MD 21076, just off I-295 and MD-100. Multiple designated parking lots are available, including standard, premium, and accessible options. On-site parking options include:

  • Live! Casino & Hotel Parking Garage: 7002 Arundel Mills Circle, Hanover, MD 21076

venueSeoContents.header: Food & Drink at The HALL at Live!
venueSeoContents.body:
The HALL at Live! offers a variety of food and beverage options, with concessions and bars located throughout the venue. Guests can enjoy a selection of snacks, light bites, and beverages from nearby service areas during events.

Guests 21 and older can purchase alcoholic beverages, including beer, wine, and cocktails, at designated bars within the venue. Food and drink options are conveniently available for purchase, allowing guests to enjoy refreshments without leaving the event space.1

Located within the Live! Casino & Hotel Maryland complex, the venue also benefits from additional dining and entertainment options nearby, giving guests even more choices for before or after a show.4

The HALL at Live! opened in 2019 and is a premier live entertainment venue located within the Live! Casino & Hotel Maryland in Hanover. With a flexible, intimate design and a capacity of approximately 4,000 guests, it has quickly become a popular destination for concerts and live events in the region.1

Since opening, the venue has hosted a variety of concerts, comedy shows, and special events, drawing audiences from across the Baltimore-Hanover area. Its modern layout and high-quality production capabilities make it an ideal setting for both touring acts and private events.1

The HALL at Live! continues to serve as a key entertainment venue within the Live! Complex, offering a dynamic space that adapts to a wide range of performances and experiences.

faqSections.sectionName: The HALL at Live! Events FAQ

faqs.question: What types of events are held at The HALL at Live!?
faqs.answer: The HALL at Live! hosts a variety of events, including concerts, comedy shows, and private events. It also accommodates special performances and entertainment experiences as part of the larger Live! complex.

faqs.question: What is the seating capacity of The HALL at Live!?
faqs.answer: The HALL at Live! has a seating capacity of approximately 4,000.1

faqs.question: Is The HALL at Live! ADA accessible?
faqs.answer: The HALL at Live! is ADA-accessible, with accessible seating and entry points. Guests can contact the venue in advance to request additional accommodations or assistance.

faqs.question: Does The HALL at Live! offer VIP or premium seating?
faqs.answer: Guests can purchase a variety of seating options for The HALL at Live! on AXS, from standard reserved seating to premium packages and suite level experiences. Availability varies, please refer to the event listings to browse available options.
